services.name: Whale Watching Trip on Monterey Bay
services.desc: Year-round whale-watching excursions from Santa Cruz, high year-round sighting rates of Humpback Whales, Gray Whales, Orcas and other marine mammals.

services.name: Monterey Sanctuary Scenic Bay Cruise
services.desc: On this fun and educational trip, you'll hear all about the Monterey Bay area while enjoying the company of some of its playful and furry inhabitants! Rates Adult: $31 Children: (Ages 4-15): $21 Infant: (Under 4 yrs) $2 (needs a ticket) includes a $2/passenger Port Fee About Sightings of Sea Lions, Otters and other marine life are common, so be sure to bring your camera! This cruise is ideal for families. On this informative tour, you'll enjoy: The Kelp Forest growing off the Point of Santa Cruz, where you can catch a glimpse of frolicking sea otters. services.name: Santa Cruz Sand Dab Fishing Trip
services.desc: Book your spot now and don't miss out on this delicious fishing opportunity! Rates Adult: $91 Children: $67 (Ages 5-15) Ride Along: $67 includes $2/passenger Port Fee About Join us for a sand dab trip on the beautiful Monterey Bay and catch the fish that fishermen love to eat! These small but tasty flat fish are known by locals as one of the best-eating fish in the ocean, and now's the best time of year to get out there and snag 'em. Come aboard one of our first-class boats, the Velocity or the Legacy, which each carry about 30 fishermen comfortably and both feature a galley. Stops along the way to catch live bait are also not uncommon. These trips will usually run from June through September on select days.
